rationale: The provided literature does not support the hypothesis that YWHAG can be reliably differentiated from YWHAZ based on epilepsy frequency and severity. In the accessible sources, YWHAG is not described or compared against YWHAZ. Furthermore, YWHAZ is cited in the context of epilepsy gene testing panels for developmental and epileptic encephalopathies (DEEs) and as a causative gene in cardiofaciocutaneous (CFC) syndrome with severe neurological involvement, failing to provide empirical cohort frequencies demonstrating that seizures in YWHAZ are reliably milder or less frequent.

new_directions.question_text: What is the exact incidence and electroclinical classification of epilepsy in a systematic cohort of patients with Popov-Chang syndrome harboring pathogenic YWHAZ variants compared to DEE-56 (YWHAG)?
new_directions.rationale: Direct side-by-side phenotyping across international registries is required to evaluate whether seizure onset, semiology, and refractoriness reliably differentiate 14-3-3 protein family channelopathies/encephalopathies.
